argumentResultMapping: Lua option keys become Hara keywords.
allowedPhases: Suspended HTTP content handlers; phase expansion is tracked by #164.
yielding: An idle checkout may complete synchronously; a new connect yields.
timeouts: A fresh connect uses the connect timeout; idle expiry is configured by `setkeepalive`.
pooling: Worker-local, destination/transport/options-sensitive idle pool with deterministic bounded eviction.
cleanupOwner: Owning request/work, explicit close or transfer, cancellation/disconnect, and worker shutdown.
authority: Request-scoped descriptor; worker owns idle entries.

argumentResultMapping: Lua backlog becomes the Hara :backlog keyword. Zero rejects at capacity; positive values admit a bounded FIFO queue and overflow is an ordinary cosocket error.
allowedPhases: Suspended HTTP content handlers; phase expansion is tracked by #164.
yielding: Queued waiters suspend without threads, condition variables, busy polling, or a second socket runtime.
timeouts: Backlog wait consumes the same connect timeout budget; only the remaining budget is available after admission.
pooling: Bounded per-pool FIFO wait queue with idle handoff before new connection creation and cancellation/removal exactly once.
cleanupOwner: Owning request/work, explicit close or transfer, cancellation/disconnect, and worker shutdown.
authority: Exact request/work/call ownership is retained while queued; native descriptors remain private to Nginx.
notes: Backlog is explicitly bounded to 0..4096 per connect request.

argumentResultMapping: Resolves `[1 nil]` on clean transfer or `[nil error]`; successful transfer retires the caller descriptor.
allowedPhases: Suspended HTTP content handlers; phase expansion is tracked by #164.
yielding: Idle transfer completes through the host Promise without blocking.
timeouts: Optional idle timeout controls monotonic expiry.
pooling: Worker-local bounded idle storage; dirty, failed, expired, or full entries are closed and never re-entered.
cleanupOwner: Owning request/work, explicit close or transfer, cancellation/disconnect, and worker shutdown.
authority: Worker owns the connection after successful transfer.

argumentResultMapping: Returns `[count nil]`; new connections report zero and each successful prior checkout increments the count.
allowedPhases: Suspended HTTP content handlers; phase expansion is tracked by #164.
yielding: Normally completes synchronously through the host Promise.
cleanupOwner: Owning request/work, explicit close or transfer, cancellation/disconnect, and worker shutdown.

openresty: one read and one write may be pending together
hoplite: one receive-side Promise plus one send-side Promise
argumentResultMapping: One receive-side Promise and one send-side Promise may be pending together. A second receive returns `[nil "socket busy reading" partial]`; a second send returns `[nil "socket busy writing"]`.
allowedPhases: Suspended HTTP content handlers; phase expansion is tracked by #164.
yielding: Read and write suspend independently on the Nginx read and write events without threads or polling.
timeouts: Independent read and write event timers; one direction never clears the other direction's timer.
pooling: Pool transfer is rejected with `connection in dubious state` while either direction is pending.
cleanupOwner: Owning request/work, explicit close or transfer, cancellation/disconnect, and worker shutdown retire both directions exactly once.
authority: Exact directional call/completer ownership plus the shared request-scoped socket lifecycle and connection generation.
notes: Connect/resolver/backlog remain in the shared lifecycle state; the established receive path and independent write sidecar share only the connection lifetime.
